claim.claim-text: 2. The method of claim 1, wherein the information indicative of the operating status of the vehicle during the LEON mode comprises at least one of a temperature of an aftertreatment system of the vehicle, a temperature of exhaust gas exiting an engine of the vehicle, a conversion efficiency of a selective catalytic reduction (SCR) catalyst of the aftertreatment system, an amount of system-out NOx, or an amount of soot on a diesel particulate filter (DPF) of the aftertreatment system.

3. The method of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the information indicative of the operating status of the vehicle during the LEON mode comprises an amount of soot build-up on a particulate filter of the aftertreatment system; and wherein the LEON exit threshold comprises a soot build-up threshold.

4. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the information indicative of the operating status of the vehicle during the LEON mode comprises an accumulated amount of EONOx; and wherein the LEON exit threshold comprises an accumulated LEON EONOx threshold.

5. The method of claim 4, wherein the information indicative of the operating status of the vehicle during the LEON mode comprises one or more warm-operation parameters; and wherein the LEON exit threshold comprises the warm-operation threshold temperature.

6. The method of claim 5, wherein disengaging the LEON mode is based on the one or more warm-operation parameters being below the one or more warm-operation thresholds and the accumulated amount of EONOx exceeding the accumulated LEON EONOx threshold.

7. The method of any preceding claim, wherein engaging the LEON mode includes at least one of increasing an exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) amount, retarding a fuel injection timing, or modifying a common rail fuel pressure.
8. A system comprising: a controller coupled to an aftertreatment system, the controller configured to:

9. The system of claim 8, wherein the information indicative of the operating status of the vehicle during the LEON mode comprises at least one of a temperature of an aftertreatment system of the vehicle, a temperature of exhaust gas exiting the component of the vehicle, a conversion efficiency of a selective catalytic reduction (SCR) catalyst of the aftertreatment system, an amount of system-out NOx, or an amount of soot on a diesel particulate filter (DPF) of the aftertreatment system.

10. The system of claim 8 or claim 9, wherein the information indicative of the operating status of the vehicle during the LEON mode comprises an amount of soot build-up on a particulate filter of the aftertreatment system;

wherein the LEON exit threshold comprises a soot build-up threshold; and wherein optionally, the amount of soot build-up on the particulate filter of the aftertreatment system is determined based on a mass flow rate of exhaust flowing through the particulate filter measured by at least one sensor.

11. The system of any claims 8 to 10, wherein the information indicative of the operating status of the vehicle during the LEON mode comprises an accumulated amount of EONOx; and wherein the LEON exit threshold comprises an accumulated LEON EONOx threshold.

12. The system of claim 11, wherein the information indicative of the operating status of the vehicle during the LEON mode comprises one or more warm-operation parameters; and wherein the LEON exit threshold comprises the warm-operation threshold temperature.

13. The system of claim 12, wherein disengaging the LEON mode is based on the one or more warm-operation parameters being below the one or more warm-operation thresholds and the accumulated amount of EONOx exceeding the accumulated LEON EONOx threshold.

14. The system of any of claims 8 to 13, wherein the information indicative of the operating status of the vehicle during the LEON mode comprises a tail pipe NOx (TPNOx) value and the LEON exit threshold is a TPNOx threshold.
